Corncob Design Language AI usage rules

- Default target: Corncob classes with vanilla HTML and JavaScript.
- React target: import components from @bootsmonday/corncob-design-language-react and styles from @bootsmonday/corncob-design-language/style.css. Do not rebuild a Corn* wrapper's internal DOM with raw classes.
- Generate markup only for components.json entries with implemented: true. Planned entries have no example on purpose.
- Default layout system: corn-container, corn-row, and corn-col-*.
- Use the grid for page and section layout unless a component page documents a different internal layout.
- Start from canonical component code before adding enhancements.
- Preserve documented class names, child order, and required wrappers.
- Always set button type to button, submit, or reset.
- For toggles, use fieldset.corn-toggle-group with legend, one shared radio name, and a label whose `for` attribute matches the corresponding input `id`.
- For icon toggles, keep icons inside labels and provide aria-label on .corn-icon.
- For sliders, wrap in corn-slider with a label, and include min, max, and value on the input.
- For selects, use corn-select custom element with option children inside corn-form--item, not a native select.
- Use corn-panel for grouped content. Do not invent corn-card or corn-alert.
- For components with required internal structure, use the grid around the component instead of rewriting the inside.
- Check components.json for canonical examples, variants, sizes, and JS requirements.
- Check tokens.json for tokens and common patterns.
- In-repo contributors and coding agents: follow AGENTS.md.
- Read guides/ai-integration/ for the full contract.
- Full AI contract: llms-full.txt

React generation

- Use the React path for .jsx, .tsx, and requests that ask for React. Keep the vanilla path for HTML.
- React 19. ref is a normal prop. The package entry is a client component ('use client').
- Page layout still uses corn-container, corn-row, and corn-col-* around the components.
- Copy the React example on the component page, or the form on /frameworks/react/, before changing content.
- className is a string. Do not invent corn-* props or classes the wrapper already applies.
- CornButton defaults to type="button". Pass type="submit" or type="reset" for those actions.
- CornCheckboxGroup, CornRadioButtonGroup, and CornToggleGroup copy name only onto direct choice children.
- indeterminate is valid on CornCheckbox only.
- CornExpandable leaves open uncontrolled unless a boolean is passed.
- CornSelect options are CornSelectOption children. The label prop is the visible label.
- status and statusVariant belong on CornTextInput, CornSelect, and CornSlider.
- Use CornPanel instead of a card and CornMessage instead of an alert.
